The entire bag is not waterproof, except for the splash-proof zipper only.


The bag often comes in 5 colors to suit all

styles of clothing, whether classic or youthful, for men and women.


The bag is suitable for laptops up to 15.6 inches.


It also comes with a belt that is attached to the body of the bag, which is not

removable but is adjustable, and the materials are washable, according to the conditions
